steps:
0. Required Roles and Access Preparation
Procedure
Open Oracle Fusion homepage.
Locate the Navigator icon with three horizontal lines in the upper-left corner.
Open the Navigator menu.
Expand the Tools section.
Click Security Console.
Open the Users tab near the upper section of the page.
Use the search field near the top-center area to locate the target user.
Click the user row from the search results table.
Click Edit near the upper-right section of the user details page.
Scroll to the Roles section.
Click Add Role.
Search for the required role name.
Select the matching role from the role search results.
Repeat for all required roles.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section of the page.
Log out and log back in to activate role changes.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
